title: OpenAI rolls out GPT-6 Astra to Pro customers on the $100/month or $200/month plans (Zac Hall/9to5Mac)
summary: Zac Hall / 9to5Mac: OpenAI rolls out GPT-6 Astra to Pro customers on the $100/month or $200/month plans — Update: A day later, GPT-6 Astra is rolling out to Pro customers on the $100/month or $200/month plan. This follows other new model releases before Plus customers on the $20/month plan gain access.
